provenance.scope: Exact full Intrusive Thoughts source with counter reminder retained; combines generic player counter meaning and Inscribe

mechanics.original_reminder: {2}{U}{B}: Exile this card from your hand inscribed on a creature you control. Whenever it attacks, its controller may cast a copy of the inscribed card without paying its mana cost. Inscribe only as a sorcery.
mechanics.executable_reminder: {Cost}, Reveal this card from your hand: Choose a creature you control. If you do, exile this card from your hand. If you do, Record that creature in the inscribed host collection of the exiled card while that source remains in exile and those members remain on the battlefield. If you do, that creature gains "Whenever this creature attacks, you may cast a copy of the exiled card without paying its mana cost." for as long as this card remains exiled and that creature remains on the battlefield only while the exiled card has custom keyword "Inscribe". Activate only if this card is in your hand. Activate only as a sorcery. This card is an Inscription in addition to its other types.

rule_text.name: 702.201a
rule_text.rule: Inscribe represents an activated ability that functions while the card with inscribe is in its owner's hand and a static ability that functions while the card with inscribe is in the exile zone. “Inscribe (cost)” means “(cost), Reveal this card from your hand: Exile this card from your hand inscribed on a creature you control. Activate this ability only at any time you could cast a sorcery.” and “For as long as this card is inscribed on that creature, that creature has 'Whenever this creature attacks, you may copy the inscribed card and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.'”

rule_text.name: 702.201b
rule_text.rule: Cards with this ability have the subtype Inscription.

rule_text.name: 702.201c
rule_text.rule: If an inscribed card somehow leaves exile, it will no longer be inscribed on that creature.

rule_text.name: 702.201d
rule_text.rule: If you copy an inscribe ability you control, only one of them will be able to exile the card from your hand and will the rest will do nothing.

rule_text.name: 702.201e
rule_text.rule: If you gain control of or copy an inscribe ability of a card you don't own, you will be unable to exile the card and the ability will do nothing.

composition_gaps: Two independently bound referents (chosen creature and exact exiled card) must survive gained trigger lowering.
Owner-hand effect constraint must apply to copied/stolen activated ability, not only to original activation cost.
Grant must disappear on either incarnation leaving its required zone; no revive when exiled card leaves and returns.
